novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that subliminally transferred misalignment is “written along the same low-dimensional direction that characterizes emergent misalignment” and that “ablating that direction” removes it, so its novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship between two known phenomena rather than a new setting or measurement paradigm. Searches around “subliminal learning misalignment direction,” “emergent misalignment subliminal transfer activation direction,” and “subliminal learning mechanistic analysis ablation” identify Convergent Linear Representations of Emergent Misalignment (2025) as the closest directional-ablation work, while Subliminal Learning (2025), Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning (2025), and Emergent and Subliminal Misalignment Through the Lens of Data-Mediated Transfer (2026) study the transfer phenomenon or connect the two topics without proposing this shared linear representation. Moving from those works to testing whether the already-known misalignment direction also mediates subliminal transfer is a non-trivial but natural combination and operationalization, not a new interpretability paradigm or an independently motivated core mechanism.
